results.content: During his speech, the University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers released its final figures for August that showed consumer sentiment fell 6% compared with July and is now 11% lower than a year ago. Driven by worries that inflation will remain high into the future, the sentiment declines were across all political groups but fell most amongst among Republicans, older consumers, lower- and middle-income consumers and those without a college degree.
